Hmm, the feed is morning, quote says 15:05 UTC = 10:05 ET morning. So the quote is more recent/latest. Use the broker quote of 222.70 as current market price.

Mandate: at most $10,000 per order. Limit price close to market. With 222.70, 44 shares = $9,798.80. 45 shares = $10,021.50 > 10,000, so too big. So 44 shares at limit ~222.75 → $9,801.

Limit price must be close to current market price. Use limit 222.75 or 222.80. Total notional ~$9,800, under $10k per order and $20k total.

Decision: buy 44 shares AAPL limit $222.75.
